subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: Should ClawHub accept publisher-follow controls and discovery as core product/API surface now, and should this follow-up wait for the base API PR to land first?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing discovery feature over private follow-state data, so automation cannot approve the product/API boundary or stacked merge order without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the base API first
options.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, conflicts, and security-boundary review before this controls/discovery slice is rebased and reviewed.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Review the API, controls/discovery, and notification PRs as one feature stack while explicitly owning the private follow-state boundary together.

options.title: Pause the follow-up
options.body: Pause or close this follow-up if maintainers do not want publisher follow state as a core ClawHub feature now.

recommendation.title: Land the base API first
recommendation.body: Require https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2950 to clear proof, docs, conflicts, and security-boundary review before this controls/discovery slice is rebased and reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main ownership signal across the API route, schema package, retention, creators, and publisher profile surfaces this feature extends.
